_comment: OmniScope Example Configuration File — copy to omniscope.json and customize

language_detection._comment_overrides: Language override rules — these override auto-detection when configured. Priority: exact > prefix(longest) > suffix(longest) > source_file > default

overrides._comment_exact: Exact symbol name → language. Use for specific functions that auto-detect gets wrong.
overrides._comment_prefix: Prefix → language. Longest prefix wins when multiple match. Use for library namespaces.
overrides._comment_suffix: Suffix → language. Longest suffix wins when multiple match.
overrides._comment_source_files: Source file basename → language. Tries basename first, then full path.
overrides._comment_default: Global default language override. Set to null to use auto-detection fallback.
